text: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the special council meeting on May 27, 2024.

Individuals interested in participating in today's meeting were eligible to register online using the delegation registration form at www.kitchener.ca slash delegation or via email at delegation at kitchener.ca.
Any written comments received prior to the commencement of today's meeting have been circulated to members of Council prior to the meeting and will form part of the public record.
The meeting live stream and archived videos are available at www.kitchen.ca slash watch now.

the gaseous fuels of tomorrow, or we could provide system-scale energy services, and
